title: 7 Trucks With the Most Recalls in 2026 (Check Yours Before 2027)
description:
The seven pickups with the biggest recall stories of 2026: what failed, how many trucks are involved, what the fix is, and how to check a truck before you buy in 2027. Every figure comes from a published source, listed below.
